verdict.rationale: Modal is a cloud platform with Python, JS and Go SDKs and a CLI, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are fair questions to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers API versioning, version pinning, changelogs or a deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path, so the documented capability is absent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
